description: Source code for command line argument parsing functions in a Zephyr-based POSIX environment, including option recognition, help message generation, and argument handling.

methods.name: cmd_is_option
methods.description: Checks if a given argument matches a specified option, considering options with or without values.

methods.name: cmd_is_help_option
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a help request option (e.g., -h, --help).

methods.name: cmd_read_option_value
methods.description: Parses and stores the value following an option string into a destination variable based on type.

methods.name: cmd_args_set_defaults
methods.description: Initializes argument structures with default values based on their type.

methods.name: cmd_print_switches_help
methods.description: Prints a short help message listing available command-line switches.

methods.name: cmd_print_long_help
methods.description: Prints a detailed help message including descriptions of all options.

methods.name: cmd_handle_this_matched_arg
methods.description: Handles a matched argument, setting its value and calling any associated callback.

methods.name: cmd_parse_one_arg
methods.description: Parses a single command-line argument, matching it against known options and processing it.
